doc: Row means grouped in 5-degree latitude bands (edges arange(-90, 90 + band, band), band k holds rows with a <= lat < b, lat = degrees of the row center); centers are the band midpoints. The smallest image, one row at latitude 0 (grid_lonlat: 90 - 0.5 * 180): only the [0, 5) band is not NaN. The row latitude is exactly 0.0 (pi / 2 - 0.5 pi), a tie that resolves the same in any language: a >= 0 goes to the band starting at 0. Centers are float64 closed-form (1e-9). The profile is a mean of float32 rows (float32 pairwise accumulation, stored dtype follows the image): float32 tolerance, measured 8e-8 absolute (1.3e-7 relative) against the same rows promoted to float64. An empty band is NaN (numpy warns).
